linear-charger-ilim-iset-programming.note: p21/p12/p34 re-read: KILIM table 1500/1610/1720 vs worked example 1550 confirmed (example also mislabels RISET). Advice to size with min 1500 is backwards: actual I=K/R can reach 1720/R, so to never exceed the limit use Kmax 1720. Envelope vin max 6.4 is the VI recommended max for 72/73/75/79; for 74 it is 10.2 V (VOVP 10.5), p5/p12/p6.
